SELECT
  ec.id::text AS execution_id,
  ec.tenant_id::text AS tenant_id,
  ec.thread_id::text AS thread_id,
  ec.trigger_message_id::text AS trigger_message_id,
  ec.idempotency_key,
  ec.status,
  CASE WHEN ec.expires_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ec.expires_at - ec.created_at))::int END AS ttl_seconds
FROM public.execution_contexts ec
WHERE ec.id = '{{ $json.execution_id }}'::uuid
  AND ec.tenant_id = '{{ $json.tenant_id }}'::uuid
  AND ec.thread_id = '{{ $json.thread_id }}'::uuid
LIMIT 1;
